source: Hourly open-meteo weather for D+1..D+6 (144 h from first_hour_ms, CET) per issue day D, in the shape the live call yields. Study issue days are stitched from the winter study's previous-runs cache (previous-runs-api, timezone Europe/Stockholm, utc_offset 3600): D+1 from *_previous_day2, D+k from *_previous_day{k+1}, the lead choice of issue_days.py. 2026-11-02 is the study's live latest-run response (live_now.py), unstitched. Wind: wind_speed_100m m/s; temperature: temperature_2m degC.
